issues.legal_issue: Whether the grant of bail was an improper exercise of judicial discretion because relevant evidence, the accused’s alleged role, the gravity of the economic offence, and its impact on victims were not adequately considered.
Whether the bail order should be set aside where the accused’s release could risk dissipation of assets allegedly acquired with misappropriated funds.
Whether allegations of a large-scale economic offence affecting many people warrant stricter and additional bail conditions.
